title: AAPS stops running loop silently (no errors)
symptom: Occasionally AAPS stops running loop. Autosens also stops updating. AAPS log shows 'Aborting calculation thread (No bucketed data available): onEventNewBG' and 'AUTOSENSDATA thread ended: onEventNewBG'.
cause: The issue seems to be something to do with how eversense logs BG data, but it may impact other sensors.
fix: Increasing the fallback threshold slightly allows loop to continue working.
evidence_quote: In this case it seems to be something to do with how eversense logs BG data but it may impact other sensors. Increasing the fallback threshold slightly allows loop to continue working.
